instruction:
Open `/home/user/Desktop/board.brd` in EAGLE and export an IPC-D-356A bare-board electrical-test netlist. Save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/board.ipc`.

The IPC-D-356A format uses fixed-width ASCII:
* `C <comment>` lines at the top
* `P JOB...` and `P UNITS` parameter lines
* `317<net><refdes><drill>A00<X><Y>...` test records, one per pad/via
* `999` trailer

Requirements:
1. File exists and is non-empty.
2. First non-empty line starts with `C`.
3. At least one `P JOB...` line.
4. At least one `317` test record.
5. Every `317` record has `D<drill>A<access>` tokens.
6. Last non-empty line is exactly `999`.
